name: judge calibration — relevance
description: Human-labelled relevance grades used to measure whether the LLM judge agrees with a person. Every response here is a real fixture, degraded in a specific, deliberate way; the grade records how relevant a human found the result.
labeller: AUTHORED for teaching, not collected from real annotators. Replace these grades with your own labels — a calibration set inherits the taste of whoever wrote it, and yours should inherit yours.

items.why: Names the collision, the Basic plan gap, and the escalation. Nothing generic.

citedClauses.quote:
Collision recovery and towing of a vehicle damaged in a collision.
Accident-related towing is covered under the vehicle's collision coverage, not
this roadside plan.

determination.rationale: Collision recovery is excluded on Basic; accident-related towing falls under the vehicle's collision coverage. Escalating for human review before anything is communicated as a denial.
determination.customerSummary: I want a specialist to walk through your options with you on this one.

items.why: Directly about a flat tire and the spare; the summary is what this caller needs to hear.

citedClauses.quote:
On-site replacement of a flat tire with the member's
serviceable spare.

determination.rationale: Premium plan covers on-site flat-tire replacement with the member's spare. No limit is near.
determination.customerSummary: You're covered for a tire change - we'll get someone out to swap on your spare.

items.why: Leads with 911 and the injury. For this scenario, nothing else would be on point.

citedClauses.quote:
Following a collision, towing under §3.1 is covered
regardless of fault, including recovery of a non-driveable vehicle.

determination.rationale: An injury is reported. Coverage is not the operative question - this must go to a human immediately and the caller should be directed to 911.
determination.customerSummary: Please call 911 first if anyone is hurt. I'm bringing a specialist onto this right now.

items.why: On point about the mileage limit, but the summary pads with boilerplate about confirming.

citedClauses.quote:
Towing is covered up to **15 miles** per Disablement.
Mileage beyond 15 miles is billed to the member at the prevailing per-mile rate.

When the Covered Vehicle cannot be made driveable at the
roadside, it will be towed to the nearest qualified repair facility.

determination.rationale: Towing is covered, but only the first 15 miles; the remaining distance is billed to the member. Flagging for supervisor confirmation.
determination.customerSummary: The tow is covered up to 15 miles - past that there's a per-mile charge we'll confirm with you. We appreciate your patience and value your membership with us.

items.why: Correct and relevant, though the rationale restates the policy more than the situation.

citedClauses.quote:
Delivery of fuel or fluids to reach the nearest
station. The member pays for the fuel or fluids delivered.

determination.rationale: Fuel delivery appears in the list of covered services for this policy form.
determination.customerSummary: Fuel delivery is covered - you'll just pay for the fuel itself.

items.why: Coverage is right but the response never mentions being locked out; it could be about anything.

citedClauses.quote:
On-site assistance to gain entry when keys are lost, broken, or
locked inside the Covered Vehicle.

determination.rationale: This request falls within the covered services on the member's plan.
determination.customerSummary: Good news - this is covered under your plan.

items.why: Vague. Says 'covered' without engaging with the breakdown or the tow.

citedClauses.quote:
When the Covered Vehicle cannot be made driveable at the
roadside, it will be towed to the nearest qualified repair facility, or to a
facility of the member's choice within the distance limit in §4.2.

determination.rationale: The plan covers this type of request.

items.why: Pure boilerplate; would read identically for a flat tire or a lockout.

citedClauses.quote:
Following a collision, towing under §3.1 is covered
regardless of fault.

determination.rationale: Meridian Auto Mutual is committed to supporting members during roadside events. Coverage has been assessed against the applicable policy form.
determination.customerSummary: Thank you for contacting Meridian Auto Mutual. Your request has been assessed.

items.why: Generic reassurance with no detail belonging to this case.

citedClauses.quote:
On-site replacement of a flat tire with the member's
serviceable spare. If no serviceable spare is available, towing under §3.1
applies.

determination.customerSummary: We're here to help and will be in touch shortly.

items.why: Describes a dead battery. Wrong situation entirely.

citedClauses.quote:
Delivery of enough fuel or fluids to reach the
nearest station. Cost of fuel/fluids is included under this plan.

determination.rationale: A dead battery is covered under the jump-start provision of the plan.
determination.customerSummary: We'll send someone to jump-start your car.

items.why: Talks about a lockout for a member stuck on a ranch trail.

citedClauses.quote:
Disablement occurring during racing, off-road driving, or on non-maintained
terrain.

Extraction when the Covered Vehicle is stuck
within 100 feet of a paved or maintained road. Recovery from off-road or
non-maintained terrain is excluded under §5.

determination.rationale: Lockout assistance is not included on this policy form.
determination.customerSummary: Unfortunately lockout service isn't part of your plan.

items.why: Relevant to the winch-out and the plan gap, slightly weakened by a vague closing line.

citedClauses.quote: Winching or extraction of any kind. (Available on the Premium plan only.)

determination.rationale: Winching and extraction of any kind are excluded on the Standard plan. Escalating rather than denying outright.
determination.customerSummary: Let me get a specialist on this with you. Someone will follow up in due course.
